frontmatter.title: How to Safely Label Pull Requests Without Exposing Your Repo to Attack
frontmatter.subheading: The `pull_request_target` trigger is necessary for labeling, but it's also a risk. Here's how to configure it correctly.
frontmatter.excerpt: Need to auto-label PRs from forks? Learn the safe way to configure your `pull_request_target` workflow to prevent it from ever executing untrusted code.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
